items.title: Dechra Acquires Animal Health Biotechnology Company Gallant Pet
items.summary: Dechra, a global leader in veterinary specialty care, recently completed its acquisition of Gallant Pet Inc, a U.S.-based animal health biotechnology company pioneering off-the-shelf mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) therapies for […] The post Dechra Acquires Animal Health Biotechnology Company Gallant Pet appeared first on Pet Age .
